description: ODC (L3c, scope phase): a setting of the data text written with a size. An ODC setting has no Length nor Decimals (ISiteProperty writes DataType, DefaultValue, IsSecret...), so the compile's set Length was refused at apply (DDL_APPLY_FAILED, labs 17 and 258, an API contracts library and a reconciliation app). The scope phase refuses it before the first op with the patch that drops the size. Runs in OdcJobTests.JobFailsWithTheTeachingMessageInTheOdcLane.
expectError: an ODC setting has no Length or Decimals
